exclusivity: data on the faction record (excludes[]). Joining over a held, excluded membership resolves IN THE OPEN — renounce, be refused, or burn the old one; which is possible is data on the pair. #270 moves only on witnessed terms: a secret defection moves nothing until seen

factionRecord.display: how membership shows when shown: insignia / uniform / recognised mark — #23 lookups, all content
factionRecord.excludes: faction ids whose membership cannot stand beside this one
factionRecord.joiningDoor: the act and its terms: a deed, a sponsor, a standing floor, or open arms
factionRecord.note: a faction is a #270 group PLUS this record; zero instanced beyond the named classes
factionRecord.questline: authored beats on #12's chain architecture, owned by the faction (the Syndicate's is the thief route's spine, #278)
factionRecord.rankLadder: named rungs; advancement = the faction's own questline beats

knowledgeRule: #270 reads membership only when the group knows it or the member shows it (a displayed insignia is a witness-carried fact, #272). Unshown membership is private truth — #281's double life is built on this seam. A faction's own members always know their own

membership.history: append-only (#126's law at faction scale): a burned membership is never deleted, only succeeded
membership.rank: DERIVED — the highest rung whose beat chain is complete; never a stored number
membership.record: { factionId, joinedBeat (#12 fact ref), status } — exactly one record per joining

classes: service bodies (when the world authors one)
namedClasses.closed: class list closed; a new class is a proposal into #299's file
namedClasses.syndicate: canon's one named faction. #99's grunt/admin/boss tiers are its ENCOUNTER face; the membership ladder is this record. #99's open slots (boss's name, motives, ranks beyond tiers) stay exactly as open as #99 left them

untouched: licence standing (#98/#133) is not a membership input; belonging never bends a battle or trial result (#151's law)
